service_error.message: No zone book is configured for AUDUSD in config/zones.json

classification: Correct validation guard (missing required manual zone book) triggered by incomplete AUDUSD configuration; not a strategy/engine/calculation bug. Secondary UX gap: /api/strategies exposes requires_zones but no zone-availability catalog, so the UI allows selecting AUDUSD+S002 and only surfaces the guarded error after submit.
